title: Claude Code 101: The workflow that changed how I build features | Robin Champsaur

facts.fact: The page says Plan Mode in Claude Code is toggled by pressing Shift + Tab twice.
facts.quote: Toggle it by pressing `Shift + Tab` twice.

facts.fact: The page says the author's guide was published on June 11, 2026.
The page says subagents can be created at project level, stored in .claude/agents/, or at user level, stored in ~/.claude/agents/.
facts.quote: create new agents at project level (stored in `.claude/agents/`) or user level (stored in `~/.claude/agents/`).

facts.fact: The page says running /agents in Claude Code opens the subagent management interface.
facts.quote: Run `/agents` in Claude Code to open the management interface.

facts.fact: The page says each subagent is a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter.
facts.quote: Each subagent is a Markdown file with YAML frontmatter:

facts.fact: The page says each subagent operates in its own context window, which keeps the main conversation clean and focused.
facts.quote: Each subagent operates in its own context window, keeping your main conversation clean and focused.

facts.fact: The page's example subagent configuration sets the model to sonnet and lists the tools Read, Edit, Bash, Grep, and Glob.
facts.value: model: sonnet; tools: Read, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob
facts.quote:
tools: Read, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob
model: sonnet

facts.fact: The page says a claude.md file should be set up in the project root as a persistent guide that Claude references on almost every prompt.
facts.quote: First thing: set up a `claude.md` file in your project root.

facts.fact: The page says that including the phrase "Use proactively" in a subagent's description field lets Claude invoke it automatically when relevant.
facts.quote: Include phrases like "Use proactively" if you want Claude to invoke it automatically when relevant.
